review.why: Plans SEO pages built at scale from templates and data, with twelve playbooks, uniqueness rules, indexation strategy and thin-content checks.
review.summary: Sets principles (unique value per page, proprietary data, subfolders, intent match), lists twelve playbooks with a chooser, then walks through pattern research, data needs, template design, hub-and-spoke linking, indexation and platform choice. It adds a pre-launch checklist, post-launch monitoring and common mistakes.
strengths: Data defensibility ranking: proprietary first, public data weakest
Strong warnings against thin pages, doorway pages and over-generation
Playbook chooser maps what you have to the page pattern
cautions: Does not generate or publish pages itself
Playbook and platform guides are in files not read here
Search-engine policy and volume data change over time
